description: Controlled single-seed 50000-round reward ablation against the matching Task 2 V4/V3.5 TD(5) experiment. Reward V3.6 preserves every ordinary action cost, environment-outcome reward, bomb-site value, the fixed 0.040 target scale, and the -1.0 self-kill penalty. It changes only auxiliary decision shaping: invalid actions, avoidably unsafe non-bomb actions, local bomb opportunities, and safe target navigation are handled by one mutually exclusive hierarchy; safe WAIT actions count as not following a directional target; and either side of a safety-filtered true conflict receives zero immediate target reward while ignoring both receives -0.040. Coin-distance and bomb-quality classes remain in the V4 Q-state only for true conflicts, allowing real future TD returns to learn their value without treating ordinal coin quarters and bomb thirds as commensurable utilities. Feature V4, five-step TD target, action space, visit-decay learning rate, epsilon schedule, gamma, checkpoint interval, seeds, training duration, and evaluation protocol are unchanged.
